ValidationRule.description: VR-QUOTE-09: Locks commercial Quote header fields once Approved. Finance, approval, and system fields remain editable. Fires only when a locked field is actually changed — flow/system updates pass through.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Approved'), NOT(ISCHANGED(Status)), OR( ISCHANGED( Contract_Term_Months__c ), ISCHANGED( Target_Site__c ), ISCHANGED( Quote_Type__c ), ISCHANGED( Amendment_Reason__c ), ISCHANGED( DE_Entity__c ), ISCHANGED( Ramp_Schedule__c ), ISCHANGED( Ramp_Phases__c ), ISCHANGED( Is_Ramp_Deal__c ), ISCHANGED( Free_Months__c ), ISCHANGED( Free_Months_Reason__c ), ISCHANGED( Free_Period_Start_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( Free_Period_End_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( FX_Rate_Model__c ), ISCHANGED( FX_Rate_Terms__c ), ISCHANGED( Tax_Treatment__c ), ISCHANGED( Target_Site__c ), ISCHANGED( Feasibility_Status__c ), ISCHANGED( Feasibility_Notes__c ), ISCHANGED( Pricebook2Id ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Quote has been approved. No changes are permitted - use Revise Quote to create a new version.
